freeDeliveryInfo: Free delivery is available for orders over 5000 UAH in our online store.  We deliver across all of Ukraine (except active combat zones), as well as internationally. All product prices can be found in the catalog. Order delivery options:

options.text: Nova Poshta Post Office (if you pay by card on the site, the option of delivery to a post office is possible
options.note: Delivery conditions to a post office: maximum order amount – 15.000 UAH.)

paymentAndTimingInfo: The delivery time depends on the remoteness of the settlement. On the site, the payment method is by   Credit / Debit Card, Google Pay, Apple Pay, LiqPay. You can calculate the delivery cost below.
